clips.password: Psst! Here is your secret bunny entrance. Type your invitation password to see the surprise!
clips.password-error: Oops! That code does not look quite right. Try another one!
clips.intro: Well, hello there! My name's Bunny. I brought a letter, a bow tie, and absolutely zero qualifications for this job.
clips.ask: Ehhh... Alex has a question for ya. He sent a rabbit. Bold choice, huh?
clips.outing: Here is the fun part. Coffee, wandering, food or sweets? I did not even put carrot farming on the list.
clips.detail-coffee: Coffee? Excellent! I like mine with two carrots. I know, I know... weird.
clips.detail-walk: I am extremely good at walking. Except when there is a carrot shop nearby.
clips.detail-food: Food? Now we are speaking my language. Does the menu have carrot cake?
clips.detail-sweet: Sweet treats! I have been training for this question my entire bunny life.
clips.detail-surprise: A surprise! Ooh, I love a mystery. Especially when nobody hides my carrots.
clips.area: Somewhere comfortable for you, of course. My hop-mobile has a very limited range.
clips.schedule: Aha! The calendar! Pick a day that works for you. This rabbit does not do surprise alarms.
clips.success: Well, would ya look at that! Mission accomplished! I knew this bow tie had magical powers!
clips.decline: Hey, no worries! Thanks for being straight with me. Here's a little flower, on the house.
clips.yes: Oh my goodness! This calls for a happy bunny dance!
clips.secret: I have a top-secret announcement. Carrots are vegetables. And I am, frankly, adorable. Please keep this confidential.
